title: Waste of money!
text: I would never buy this again. This was $23 with my discount ... if I were to go to the store, I could get at least double (if we got double in this box, I might stay subscribed. But not for this!!). These are very tiny treats, extremely thin. Gnaw box is a great box. We are currently subscribed to that one and we are looking for an add on for some fun- this is definitely not it!
label: neutral
